subject: Constant entry
notes: kb/Work PB1231 (w1007c), extended by kb/Work PB1941 (w1032a). cite.py --check 13.10.3 "The length of data-name-1 or data-name-2 shall not be dependent, directly or indirectly, upon the value of constant-name-1" -> OK SR4. The constant table is not filled in declaration order: every constant entry is declared before anything binds (DataBinder.DeclareDataEntries), FindConstant binds one on demand, and a length phrase may measure an item described later. A later RECORD is bound out of source order (BindLaterRecords); since PB1941 a later entry of the record STILL BEING DESCRIBED is bound ahead at the granularity of its own entry (BindLaterEntriesOfOpenRecord: the entry and its subordinates, plus each group entry between it and its nearest bound ancestor, linked to that ancestor and attached by the walk at their source position; a group bound alone is completed before it is measured, CompletePreboundGroup). The circular shapes are refused BY NAME: `01 K CONSTANT AS LENGTH OF W. 01 W PIC X(K).` (IsBeingDescribed), `01 G. 05 G1 PIC X(KG). 01 KG CONSTANT AS LENGTH OF G.` (IsDescriptionOpen), a constant cycle through a length phrase (ReportConstantCycle), and inside an open record `01 R. 05 A PIC X(K). 05 W. 10 WA PIC X(K). 01 K CONSTANT AS LENGTH OF W.` -> COBOL1547 '... (ISO 13.10.3 SR4)' (negatives pb1231-constant-length-cycle, pb1941-constant-length-cycle-open-record at 2002/2014/2023). The legal neighbours compile: A is X(7) with W in a later record, and inside one open record R: K = LENGTH OF W OF G = 7, KG = LENGTH OF G = 20 (G holds Z PIC X(K): G depends on K, never on KG), KT = BYTE-LENGTH OF TE (2) = 2, R = 57 (golden pb1941_constant_length_inside_open_record). Residue (not SR4's rule, the forward-reference service, kb/Work PB1941): an operand SUBORDINATE to the very entry whose description references the constant (`05 A OCCURS K. 10 W PIC X(4).`) is COBOL0899 constant-length-operand-bound-later. || editions 2002,2014,2023 (kb/Work PB3173, S0b; DESIGN-conformance-suite.md §6 step 0): a constant-entry rule; the constant entry (level 01 CONSTANT) is a COBOL-2002 introduction. cite.py --check 13.10.3 "The length of data-name-1 or data-name-2 shall not be dependent" OK.
